age_and_r2_acceptance.target: Each object produces one reusable age ciphertext; R2 accepts ciphertext only and verifies a full cipher SHA-256 after readback. Plaintext and private identities do not leave the local boundary or enter logs.

blocking_oracle.single_ciphertext: AgeEncryptor validates the registered plaintext SHA before encryption, keys its deterministic ciphertext/manifest path by original SHA, and reuses it only when the recipient fingerprint and ciphertext SHA still match. A recipient change invalidates the old cache and creates one replacement ciphertext, not a second remote payload.
blocking_oracle.ciphertext_only_r2: S3ReplicaStore rejects non-.age or wrong-hash input, uploads only the ciphertext path, records original/cipher SHA and age algorithm metadata, validates remote metadata, then verifies the complete downloaded ciphertext SHA before a replica can be marked verified.
blocking_oracle.cli_confirmation_and_fail_closed: The frozen Task Pack invocation --store r2 --encrypted-canary is accepted. A remote write/read/delete canary now requires that explicit flag; a bare --store returns BLOCKED_USER_CONFIRMATION. Missing recipient/configuration returns nonzero BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT instead of an argparse error or a successful exit.
blocking_oracle.completion_boundary: R2 is only the first replica. OCI remains blocked behind verified R2 and GitHub remains the third encrypted receipt; an artifact cannot become complete until all three records have the same cipher SHA, original SHA, and encryption algorithm.

fixture_coverage.age_reuse: Fake age runners prove one encryption call for the same content/recipient, stable cipher SHA/path, and a necessary re-encryption after recipient change.
fixture_coverage.r2_metadata_and_readback: Fake S3 clients prove upload receives only .age ciphertext, metadata includes both hashes and age algorithm, an exact readback publishes the target, and a mismatched readback raises while deleting its temporary file and never publishing the target.
fixture_coverage.taskpack_cli_contract: A dynamically loaded probe script accepts the exact frozen --store r2 --encrypted-canary spelling. With recipient and R2 configuration removed, it exits 3 with BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT before an S3 client or age process is created; bare --store exits 3 with BLOCKED_USER_CONFIRMATION.
fixture_coverage.pipeline_and_completion: Related fixtures prove R2 replica records carry the cipher SHA/readback evidence, OCI queue selection requires verified R2, and three identical R2/OCI/GitHub receipts are required for completion.

age_and_r2_acceptance.blocking_result: The frozen SA-501 pytest command passed 8/8. Related encryption/replication/completion regression passed 15/15. The full project suite passed 161/161.

semantic_reconciliation.reason: The frozen age implementation was already semantically valid. A minimal upstream adaptation reconciles the frozen Task Pack CLI spelling and hardens blocked-environment exit semantics without altering the transaction/recovery core or starting OCI/GitHub replication.

execution_corrections: The SA-501 Task Graph invokes probe_object_store.py with --store r2 --encrypted-canary, while the frozen implementation only accepted a positional store and silently treated BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT as exit 0. The adapter now accepts the frozen spelling, preserves the old positional form, requires explicit write confirmation, and returns nonzero for blocked environment state.
Readback coverage previously exercised only a matching ciphertext. A new fixture proves a wrong ciphertext SHA raises, removes the temporary download, and never publishes a target file.
residual_risk_and_non_claims: No real R2, OCI, GitHub, Cloudflare, account, credential, provider request, age binary invocation, ciphertext upload, remote readback/delete, data upload, Docker action, deployment, Git stage/commit/push/merge/rebase, new worktree, legacy ignored-runtime access, or destructive cleanup occurred. Unit fixtures use temporary fake age/S3 clients only.

The isolated command deliberately removes all provider environment values and reports BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT. It proves CLI compatibility and fail-closed behavior, not R2 account access, bucket privacy, free-tier availability, real cipher persistence, or remote readback.

The real Owner-authorized R2 encrypted canary remains NOT_RUN. Its prerequisite is an explicit owner-approved recipient and R2 configuration; it must remain separate from fixture PASS and must never expose plaintext or a private identity.

OCI, GitHub encrypted third replica, Private-Database completion synchronization, operations recovery, and final release gates remain unfinished in SA-502 through SA-507. No intermediate Git publication is authorized before the full Task Pack passes.

source_change.product_source_rewrite: No broad rewrite. The existing one-cipher encryption core and R2 replica implementation remain intact; the change is limited to the frozen CLI compatibility/safety boundary and its fixture coverage.
